## Summary

Telemetry TM-PWR-02 shows end-of-eclipse battery voltage residuals of -0.04 V across three eclipses, indicating a deeper discharge than the spec-sheet model predicts. The build record NCR-005 reveals the battery pack’s actual capacity is 9.6 Ah (vs. 10.0 Ah required), dispositioned “Use-as-is under requirement deviation” for flight, which adds about 4 % more depth-of-discharge per eclipse. This capacity shortfall pushes the forecast depth-of-discharge from 19.6 % (spec) to 20.4 % (as-built), exceeding the 20 % limit and triggering FDIR event FE-301. Proposed payload load shed for session XB-0412 reduces load, bringing the as-built depth-of-discharge to 17.4 % and keeping the battery within safe limits. No hardware repair is possible on orbit; the discrepancy will be addressed via a future flight NCR on the next build.
